name: NOVA mini arm drive B1+ FIXER revision (R2c/oprava): judge B1+ with the verifier fixes
frame: B: mm, Z up, front -Y, robot left +X. LEFT side values; RIGHT = mirror x -> -x (all checks both sides).

servo.model: Feetech SCS0009 / Waveshare SC09, ears cut off
servo.note: official drawing: 25.25 to the top face (bottom z -70.25), body shoulder 21.45; v2 model used 21.5 -> measure, see open items

path_A_horn.horn_pocket: hub D7.4 x 4.1 with flats AF 6.2, bonded 2K epoxy, shoulder above the hub
path_A_horn.ledge_z: horn hub top + screw head height + 0.2 (nominal -38.4 with DIN 912 M2, hub top -40.6)

path_B_printed_spline.z_bottom: 0.3 above the highest point of the servo top (nominal -44.7)
path_B_printed_spline.spline: 20T internal, OD 3.95 / root 3.45, to z -41.6, coupons on diameter +0/+0.02/+0.04/+0.06

coupler.screw: DIN 912 / ISO 4762 M2 (head D3.8 x 2.0), length so that >= 3 mm engages the servo spline thread (path B nominal M2x5; check the thread on arrival)

vertical_shaft.note: hex bottoms on the coupler ledge; the D3->D2.5 step is >= 0.85 below the pinion for every shim; service lift 3.5 needed, 4.5 max

MR63ZZ_B1.seat: v2 tongue ring r 3.0..4.4, epoxied outer race

pinion_shim.rule: never above 0.57 (depth margin); if the backlash is still too large at 0.57 print the tooth-thickness coupon with thicker flanks

gear_18T.bore: printed M4x0.7 internal thread (+0.1 radial clearance), screwed on the M4 and epoxied (JUDGE FIX, was plain D4.1)

gear_shim.pick: dry fit before bonding: caliper depth from the plug neck face (x 38.6) to the gear toe face (x 41.84) = 3.24 +- 0.03

MR74_A1.inner: 2K epoxy on the thread (Loctite 638 optional, then activator 7649 needed on zinc)

MR74_A2.outer: EPOXIED against the outboard shoulder at x 55.10 (JUDGE FIX: inward axial stop)
MR74_A2.inner: 2K epoxy on the thread (Loctite 638 optional, then activator 7649 needed on zinc)

arm_shaft_M4x20.std: DIN 912 / ISO 4762 M4x20 8.8 zinc, fully threaded, major dia >= 3.93 by calipers
arm_shaft_M4x20.bond: 2K epoxy on the A1/A2 zones, head set 0.5 off the seat end with a printed gauge fork while curing; then clip in the C-shim
arm_shaft_M4x20.select: major diameter >= 3.93 preferred, >= 3.90 accepted; measure the head diameter (plain or knurl crest) for the drive-hub coupons

plug_zatka.slot_6oclock: |y-3| <= 5.1 for x < 44.0, open to -X (JUDGE: 5.1 instead of B1 5.3; 0.60 to the pinion crown, 0.89 wall to the M2 inserts)

stop_lug.contacts: rib meets it at arm -51.0 and +135.5 deg; gap 0.576 at -45, 0.528 at +130

screws.8 o'clock: M2x10 with the countersink sunk 1.3 deeper (tip 35.19, engaged 3.21; insert hole floor x 34.9)

plug_zatka.pegs: 2 printed D2.4 at r 9.0, 10 and 2 o'clock

arm_hub.bearing: 6800ZZ or 6800-2RS (61800), 10x19x5, x 55.3..60.3, outer race epoxied in the hub bore D19, inner race slip on the D10 seat (4.2 of 5.0 supported)

washer_DIN125_M10.bond: smooth (burr-free) face = friction face, flush to the reference; burr side into the recess

arm_hub.fallback: B1+ 6700ZZ hub (bore D15, x 55.5..59.5, judge numbers) is a drop-in alternative print if only a 6700 can be bought

drive_hub.magnet_pockets: 8x D5.1 at r 7.7, open outboard, depth 2.8 (magnet 2.0 + printed spacer up to 0.8)

clutch.magnets: NdFeB 5x2 axial N38, symmetric patterns 2/4/6/8, spacers 0/0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 (force x 1/0.72/0.54/0.41/0.33)

coin_test.hook: printed tip clip, thread hole on the arm axis R 55.0 from the shoulder axis

homing: two slow sweeps at the running torque limit: to the servo low end (arm stops at -51, clutch slips), then to the high end (arm stops at +135.5). Servo travel needed >= 284 deg (span 186.5 x 1.5 + margin).

column.upper_fill: judge colfill_B1merge clipped: x >= 31.3 for anything above z -48.5 (deck path), outside x >= 32.65 & y -14.6..9.2 below z -44.5 (servo corridor)
column.torsion_web: new: between the legs z -35.0..-27.0, x 33.5..41.5 within the free map, y -9.0..7.5, keep-out r 3.4 about (39, 3) (lifted 5 AF hex), x <= 38.8 inside r 16.3 of the shoulder axis
column.voxels: /tmp/claude-0/gapwf/fin/R2c/oprava/colfill_fix_L.npz / _R.npz (P = centres; R in real x < 0; key 'web' = web voxels)
exact_cutters_for_CAD: servo: y >= 9.2 or y <= -14.6 where x >= 32.65 and z < -44.5
coupler: cylinder r 5.0 about (39,3) z -44..-35 and slab y -1.8..7.8, x >= 34.2, z -44..-35
T_stred path 0.5, cap path 0.3, sweep 1.0 (free map)
column.fillets: R >= 1.0 at the pocket inner corners (front leg / pad / web), at the leg-boss junction and around the cable slot
column.FE: column alone still above 8.5 MPa at +135 (fe_col_summary.json) - T_spodok must not be printed before the CAD FE with the deck tie passes

tooth_thickness_coupons: pairs with flank offsets -0.02 (design) / 0.00 / -0.04 per flank; pick the pair giving the target backlash at the nominal shim 0.42

thrust_C_shim.function: inward stop between the seat end and the M4 head / drive-hub boss, gap 0.03-0.05 (engages before the 0.113 mm axial move that would jam the mesh)
